book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Luk beleŋ Yesu niŋ yitiŋ mere igiŋ kayyiŋ

content: Satan beleŋ Yesu tuŋaŋ uryiŋ
Be, Yesu gob Yodan fete Yon hitte baptais teŋbe fe go tubul teŋ kuriŋ. Goya goyenbe Holi Spirit beleŋ ketal urdeb teŋ sawsawa po kuruŋ naŋa bana goŋ tukuriŋ.

Goŋ kuŋbe naŋkahal 40 hinhin. Goyare goyenbe Satan beleŋ mata buluŋ kurayen kurayende tuŋaŋ urtiŋde hinhin. Goŋ hinhin goya goyenbe biŋge kutŋaŋre hinhin geb, kuŋ kuŋ naŋkahal 40 go muruŋde hekeb biŋge buluŋ wor po iryiŋ.
Be, Satan beleŋ goyen keneŋbe hora kura ikala irde, “Gebe fudinde Al Kuruŋ Urmiŋ kenem hora ga inke beret hekeb nawa,” inyiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Al Kuruŋyen asaŋdeb, ‘Albe biŋge hende po ma haŋyen,’ yitiŋ hi,” inyiŋ.
Be, gor matbe Uŋgura gore Yesu go naŋa kota tukuŋbe alya bereya megen haŋ kuruŋ goyen wawuŋ uŋkureŋde po ikala iryiŋ.
Irdeb, “Megen haŋ mar kuruŋ gayen doyaŋ yird yird saŋiŋ gobe ne nuntiŋ. Niŋgeb al kura une yeŋbe igiŋ ala yubul teŋ uneŋ. Niŋgeb guneŋ.
Goyenbe mali ma guneŋ. Turuŋ nirde doloŋ nirke gab det kuruŋ goyen yubul teŋ gunmeke gere henayiŋ,” inyiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Al Kuruŋyen asaŋdebe, ‘Al Kuruŋ po gab dende Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ geb, yeŋ po ga turuŋ irde doloŋ irde yeŋ ge po meteŋ teŋ hinayiŋ,’ yitiŋ goyen go ma nurde ha?” inyiŋ.
Be, Uŋgura go Yesu teŋ Yerusalem tukuŋbe Al Kuruŋyen ya balem kuruŋ hende hoyaŋ goyenter teŋ hurkuriŋ. Irdeb gaha inyiŋ: “Al Kuruŋyen asaŋdebe,

content.text: ‘Ge niŋ teŋbe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ miyoŋmiŋ yinke keŋkela doyaŋ girnayiŋ.
Irdeb gakteŋ mugunyeŋ goyenbe haniŋde gisaŋ heke kahaŋge hora beleŋ muŋ kura umulaw ma uryeŋ,’ yitiŋ. Tikiŋ 91:11-12

content: Niŋgeb gebe Al Kuruŋ Urmiŋ kenem gar gare solok yeŋ kurka,” inyiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Al Kuruŋyen mere asaŋde kura katiŋbe, ‘Al Kuruŋ po ga Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋge. Niŋgeb tuŋaŋ urde tebaŋ ma irayiŋ,’ yitiŋ hi,” inyiŋ.
Be, Uŋgura gobe Yesu tuŋaŋ urmaŋ urmaŋbe bada heŋ kurare kura ga sopte tuŋaŋ ureŋ yeŋbe tubul teŋ kuriŋ.
Nasaret niŋ marbe Yesu niŋ bada hamiŋ
Be, Yesu go Holi Spirit ketal urde tareŋ irke mulgaŋ heŋ Galili naŋare kuriŋ. Irdeb meteŋ teŋ hikeb al Galili naŋa bana hinhan kuruŋ goyen mere momoŋmiŋ nurtiŋ ala tiyamiŋ.
Yeŋbe Yuda marte gabu yayaŋ kuŋ al saba yirde hinhin. Irkeb al meremiŋ nurde hinhan goreb turuŋ irde hinhan.

Be, Galili naŋa bana goŋ meteŋ teŋ heŋyabe Nasaret kuriŋ. Yeŋbe taun goyenter heŋ kuruŋ hiriŋ. Be, yeŋbe Sabat nalure hugiŋeŋ teŋ hinhin gwahade goyen po, Sabat nalu hekeb Yuda marte gabu yare kuriŋ. Irdeb Al Kuruŋyen mere kapyaŋ hewe yeŋ huwaryiŋ.
Irkeb gabu ya goyenter niŋ meteŋ faraŋ al kura beleŋ asaŋ kura Al Kuruŋyen mere basaŋ al Aisaia beleŋ kayyiŋ bili irtiŋ hinhin goyen teŋ Yesu unyiŋ.
Irkeb hol irde mere kura katiŋ goyen keneŋbe kapyaŋ hiriŋ. Merebe gahade:

content.text: “Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋbe alya bereya yumulgaŋ teŋ teŋ mere igiŋ goyen al buniŋeŋ momoŋ yirde saba yirde hayiŋ yeŋ basiŋa niryiŋ.
Irde nad nerke kweŋ timekeya, ‘Kuŋbe kanduk bana haŋ mar goyen faraŋ yurde yad siŋa yirayiŋ,
irde al diliŋ titmiŋbe sope yirayiŋ,’ ninuŋ.
Irdeb, ‘Al buluŋyen yufukde heŋ goltapŋeŋ nurde haŋ mar goyen faraŋ yurde yad siŋa yirayiŋ,
irde Al Kuruŋ beleŋ alya bereya igiŋ yird yird nalube gago waya yeŋ momoŋ yirayiŋ,’ ninuŋ.
Niŋgeb goke teŋbe Doyaŋ Al Kuruŋ beleŋ basiŋa niryiŋ geb, Holi Spirit beleŋ ketal nurtiŋ hime,” yitiŋ hi. Aisaia 61:1-2; 58:6

content: Be, kapyaŋ heŋ pasi irdeb asaŋ go bili irdeb tumulgaŋ teŋ gabu yare gor niŋ meteŋ al go uneŋbe kipiryiŋ. Irkeb al buda gor hinhan kuruŋ go diliŋbe Yesu hende po iramiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ, “Mere kapyaŋ hemeke nurhaŋ gote igineŋbe ne gago nenhaŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Be, gor hinhan mar gobe tumŋaŋ sabamiŋ igiŋ nurde yeŋ ge tagalamiŋ. Irde meremiŋbe tareŋ miŋyaŋ wor po goyen nurdeb dinoŋ kok yamiŋ. Gega Yesu go keneŋ bebak teŋbe, “Al gabe Yosep urmiŋ moŋ?” yamiŋ.

Mel gore gwaha yeke nurdeb Yesu beleŋ gaha yinyiŋ: “Deŋbe al beleŋ mere kura gahade teŋ hike nurde haŋyen. Mere gobe gahade: ‘Guram al, neŋ sope dire yeŋbe gigeŋ wa sope irayiŋ,’ yeŋ haŋyen. Niŋgeb gwahade goyen po ne gayen deŋ beleŋbe, ‘Tiyuŋger gar gayen Kapeneam taunde mata teŋ hike nurtiŋ goyen tike dilniniŋde yentek,’ ninniŋ tahaŋ.
Gwahade yenayiŋ gega, fudinde wor po dineŋ hime, Al Kuruŋyen mere basaŋ marbe tiyuŋmiŋde niŋ mar beleŋ meremiŋ nurtek ma yirkeb yakira teŋ haŋyen,” yinyiŋ.

Irde sopte gaha yinyiŋ: “Fudinde wor po dineŋ hime. Al Kuruŋyen mere basaŋ al Elaia hinhin nalureb Al Kuruŋ beleŋ naŋkiŋ pet tikeb dama karwo irde gagasi 6 gayen kigariŋ yilik muŋ kura ma tiyyiŋ. Gwaha tikeb Israel naŋa kuruŋ gobe biŋge kamde kamde nalu kuruŋ forok yiriŋ. Goyare goyen bana goŋbe beretap budam hinhan.
Gega Elaiabe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ Israel niŋ beretap kura hitte ma teŋ kerke kuriŋ. Gwaha irtiŋeŋbe Saidon naŋa bana goŋ niŋ beretap kura Sarefat taunde hinhin geb, Elaia go teŋ kerke yeŋ hitte kuriŋ.

Be, Al Kuruŋyen mere basaŋ al kura Elisa hinhin nalureb Israel naŋarebe al budam busuka miŋyaŋ hinhan. Gega yeŋbe Israel al kura ma sope iryiŋ. Gwaha irtiŋeŋbe al miŋ hoyaŋ Siria naŋare niŋ al Naman po gab sope iryiŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Be, Yesu beleŋ gwaha yinkeb al gabu ya bana hinhan mar kuruŋ gobe biŋ ar yamiŋ.
Irkeb huwarde Yesu go hamulare tukuŋ timiyniŋ yeŋ upepel urde teŋ taun siŋakde naŋa hamulare gor teŋ kwamiŋ.
Gega Yesu gobe daha mat wet kura al buda goyen kahal pota yirde kuriŋ.
Yesu beleŋ uŋgura takira tiyyiŋ
Be, Yesube gor mat Galili naŋare niŋ taun kura Kapeneam gor kurkuriŋ. Irdeb kuŋ gor Sabat nalu hekeb Yuda marte gabu yare hurkuŋ al saba yiryiŋ.
Irke gor hinhan mar beleŋ sabamiŋ saŋiŋ miŋyaŋ geb, pel irtek moŋ yeŋ nurdeb diliŋ fot yamiŋ.
Be, gabu ya bana goyenbe al uŋguram yaŋ kura hinhin. Be, al gore kekew teŋbe,
“Ey, Yesu Nasaret niŋ al! Gebe daha dire yeŋ wayha? Buluŋ dire yeŋ wayha? Gebe al gwahade yeŋ nurd guneŋ hime. Gebe Al Kuruŋyen, Al Wukkeŋ wor po!” inyiŋ.
Irkeb Yesu beleŋ misiŋeŋ po, “Bada hawa. Irde al go tubul teŋ kat kwa!” inyiŋ. Irkeb uŋgura goreb gabu iramiŋ mar diliŋ mat po al go temeyke katkeb tubul teŋ kuriŋ. Gega al gobe dagi kura ma tiyyiŋ.

Irkeb gor hinhan mar gore mata go keneŋbe hurkuŋkat wor po teŋ yiŋgeŋ uliŋ, “Saba gabe dahade wor po? Turŋuŋ yaŋ wor po. Irde meremiŋ pel irtek moŋ, tareŋ miŋyaŋ geb, go hende uŋgura yakira tikeb kat kwahaŋ!” yamiŋ.
Be, Yesu beleŋ mata tiyyiŋ gote mere momoŋbe alya bereya tiyuŋ Kapeneam taun biŋyaŋ hinhan goyen nurde tukutiŋ ala tiyamiŋ.
Yesu beleŋ al garbam miŋyaŋ budam sope yiryiŋ

Be, Yesu gobe Yuda marte gabu ya go tubul teŋbe Saimon, deŋem kurabe Pita gote yare kuriŋ. Goya goyenbe Saimon teŋakbe aygaŋ buluŋ wor po irke Saimonyen yare hinhin. Niŋgeb faraŋ uri yeŋ Yesu momoŋ iramiŋ.
Irkeb kuŋ gasuŋmiŋ ketalde huwarde urguŋ kaŋ keneŋbe aygaŋ go kwep irde takira tikeb tubul tiyyiŋ. Irkeb bere gobe goyare po huwardeb Yesuya yeŋya wayamiŋ mar goke biŋge kayyiŋ.

Be, naŋa gurgur yeŋ hikeb Sabat nalu hubu hiriŋ geb, igiŋ det kanduk yad belen kutek hamiŋ. Irkeb al garbam miŋ kurayen kurayen Yesu hitte yawayamiŋ. Irkeb yuŋkureŋ yuŋkureŋ haniŋ uliŋde yerdeb guram yirde tukukeb igiŋ hamiŋ.

Goyenbe garbam po ma sope yiryiŋ. Uŋgura al uliŋde hinhan goyen manaŋ yakira tike al budam yubul teŋ kat kwamiŋ. Uŋgura goyen Yesube Mesaia yeŋ nurde uneŋ hinhan geb, kat kuŋ heŋyabe kekew teŋ, “Gebe Al Kuruŋ Urmiŋ!” ineŋ hinhan. Gega Yesu beleŋbe mere tinak yeŋ yineŋ teŋ utaŋ yirde hinhin.

Be, naŋa hako ga fay urde hikeb Yesu go naŋa migiriŋ miŋmoŋde kura gor kuriŋ. Irkeb al beleŋ yeŋ ge naŋkeneŋ hinhan. Naŋkeneŋ kuŋ kuŋbe yeŋ hinhinde gor forok yeŋ kenamiŋ. Irdeb, “Dubul ma teŋ kwayiŋ. Gaŋ po hayiŋ,” ineŋ basiŋa iramiŋ.
Gega Yesu beleŋ wol heŋbe, “Moŋ, nebe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ alya bereyamiŋ doyaŋ yird yird mere igiŋ goyen tiyuŋ hoyaŋde manaŋ tagalde kuŋ heŋ. Goke teŋbe Al Kuruŋ beleŋ nad nerke wamiriŋ,” yinyiŋ.
Irdeb Yuda marte naŋa bana kuruŋ go kuŋ heŋya gabu yayaŋ mere tagalde kuŋ hinhin.

footnotes.text: Asaŋ gobe Aisaia beleŋ haŋkapya kayyiŋ wor po goyen moŋ. Gabe basaŋ heŋ sopte kayamiŋ kuruŋ goyen kuramiŋbe gago.
